purpose: This table is the cleaned carrier lookup for the nycflights13-derived bronze dataset, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full airline name for the sixteen carriers that flew from New York City in 2013; it is intended to be joined against flight-level fact tables on the carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join on carrier to resolve full airline names for flight records; both carrier and name are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and carrier is unique across all 16 rows, so no null-handling or duplicate-filtering logic is required for this table.
limitations: The table is a small static reference (16 rows, duplicate_row_rate 0.0) with no observed data quality issues; however, it only covers carriers that flew from NYC in 2013 and will not include carriers introduced or retired since, so joins against newer flight data may produce unmatched carrier codes.
